CREATE TABLE "public"."Decimals" (
  "id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "long" numeric(65,30) DEFAULT '12345678901234567890.123456789'::numeric(65,30) NOT NULL,
  "tiny" numeric(65,30) DEFAULT '0.000000000000000001'::numeric(65,30) NOT NULL,
  "negative" numeric(65,30) DEFAULT '-1.5'::numeric(65,30) NOT NULL,
  "whole" numeric(65,30) DEFAULT '42'::numeric(65,30) NOT NULL,
  "zerosBare" numeric DEFAULT '1.50'::numeric NOT NULL,
  "zerosScaled" numeric(10,2) DEFAULT '1.50'::numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "zerosDefault" numeric(65,30) DEFAULT '1.50'::numeric(65,30) NOT NULL,
  "list" numeric(65,30)[] DEFAULT ARRAY['1.50', '-2', '0.000000000000000001']::numeric(65,30)[],
  "bigLong" int8 DEFAULT '9007199254740993'::int8 NOT NULL,
  "bigList" int8[] DEFAULT ARRAY['9007199254740993', '-1']::int8[],
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
